summary: Enterprise prospect requesting SOC 2 Type II report + details on data retention/deletion controls (Hosted/Dedicated/Private)
description:
Issue summary:
Aurora Financial (enterprise prospect, security + procurement review) requested:
1) Redwood SOC 2 Type II report (under NDA) and summary of scope/period.
2) Clear explanation of data retention and deletion controls across deployment modes (Hosted API, Dedicated, Private/VPC), including:
   - Prompt/completion content retention (if any)
   - Application/request logs retention
   - Audit log retention and export options
   - Deletion process and timelines
   - Ability to configure retention / customer-managed logging

Impact:
Blocking items for security questionnaire completion and procurement timeline. AE requested an answer pack they can forward same week.

Customer questions (verbatim from AE notes):
- "Can you share your SOC 2 Type II report and bridge letter if applicable?"
- "Do you retain prompts and completions? If yes, for how long and can it be configured to 0 days?"
- "What logs do you store (API request metadata, payloads, admin actions), and what are retention defaults?"
- "Can audit logs be exported to our SIEM and retained in our environment only?"
- "For Dedicated/Private, can we require no storage of customer content and set our own retention?"

Requested deliverables:
- SOC 2 Type II report delivery path + expected turnaround time
- Short, customer-forward narrative on retention/deletion + links to canonical docs

Contacts:
- Request came via Sales (AE) with Security/GRC escalation.

Attachments/links referenced in request:
- None from customer; they asked for Redwood-provided evidence and policy language.
internal_notes:
Triage notes (Support):
- Treat SOC 2 report as restricted evidence: must follow evidence request playbook, confirm NDA in place, and use approved language (no over-claiming, no roadmap promises).
- Customer has repeated focus on "0-day retention" and audit log export to SIEM; ensure we differentiate:
  (a) customer content (prompts/completions)
  (b) operational logs (request metadata, errors)
  (c) audit logs (admin actions)
- Use the canonical retention/deletion overview page and the standard FAQ language; avoid ad-hoc phrasing.

Evidence handling:
- SOC 2 Type II report is stored in restricted compliance evidence folder. If the AE/SE needs access to send securely, route through GRC.
- Confirm NDA status before releasing report; if missing, initiate NDA workflow via Sales + Legal.

Recommended sources / approved language:
- SOC 2 evidence request process: sources/confluence/security-and-compliance/compliance-evidence/soc2-customer-evidence-request-playbook.json
- Customer-facing retention language: sources/confluence/security-and-compliance/data-residency-and-retention/customer-facing-data-retention-and-deletion-overview.json
- Audit log overview & export options: sources/confluence/security-and-compliance/audit-logging/audit-logging-customer-overview.json
- Security FAQ (customer-facing) for data use/training + retention Qs: sources/confluence/sales-enablement/security-faq/redwood-enterprise-security-faq-2026.json

Cross-functional pings:
- GRC: Daniel Carter to manage SOC 2 report release and confirm current audit period wording.
- Security reviewer (if wording questions arise): Olga Petrov / Marcus Lin.

Risks / things NOT to say:
- Do not claim ISO 27001 certification.
- Do not promise "0 retention" globally unless tied to a specific deployment mode/control that is currently supported; stick to documented capabilities and configuration options.

Field note:
- This request appears related to the ongoing Aurora Financial security review thread (CISO escalation). Ensure consistent narrative across email + ticket response.

resolution:
Provided Sales/AE with approved, customer-forward language covering:
- SOC 2 Type II report availability and release process under NDA (no report shared prior to NDA).
- Canonical explanation of data retention, deletion, and log/audit log retention boundaries across deployment modes.
- Pointers to audit logging overview (including export options) and reminders on approved phrasing.

GRC (Daniel Carter) to deliver SOC 2 Type II report via secure channel once NDA is confirmed executed.
next_steps: AE to confirm NDA execution date and intended recipients; once confirmed, GRC to send SOC 2 Type II report.

If Aurora Financial requires specific retention values/configurations not covered by canonical docs, route to Solutions Engineering + Product Security PM for capability confirmation (no roadmap commitments).
If customer asks whether Redwood trains on customer data, reuse the approved FAQ language and reference SUP-28790 for the standard response.
